title: 2026 Gitelman-like Syndrome (次發性與繼發性 Gitelman 樣症候群) 分子調控機轉、藥物與自體免疫致病原因、臨床鑑別診斷與專科試題實戰

questions.stem: Which transport protein located on the apical membrane of the distal convoluted tubule (DCT) is primarily mutated in hereditary Gitelman syndrome, leading to impaired sodium and chloride reabsorption?
questions.sourceExplanation: Gitelman Syndrome 是一項體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，病因在於編碼 Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT) 頂端膜上 Thiazide-sensitive Na-Cl cotransporter (NCCT) 的 SLC12A3 基因發生失能型突變。此轉運體負責 DCT 主要的 NaCl 重吸收，其失能直接導致顯著的 Salt Wasting 與續發性電解質異常。

questions.stem: A 32-year-old female presents with recurrent muscle cramps and severe hypomagnesemia. Dysregulation of which apical membrane channel in the distal convoluted tubule is directly responsible for renal magnesium wasting in Gitelman syndrome?
questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT) 中，頂端膜的跨細胞 Mg2+ 重吸收主要依賴 TRPM6 鎂離子通道。在 Gitelman Syndrome 中，由於 NCCT 缺失導致 DCT 細胞結構萎縮及 EGF 調控異常，TRPM6 通道表現量被顯著下調，進而引發嚴重的 Renal Magnesium Wasting 與持續性 Hypomagnesemia。

questions.stem: Phosphorylation and cell-surface expression of the Na-Cl cotransporter (NCCT) in the distal convoluted tubule are stimulated by which intracellular signaling cascade?
questions.sourceExplanation: NCCT 在 DCT 頂端膜的磷酸化與膜表達高度仰賴 WNK Kinases (如 WNK4) 及其下游 SPAK (Ste20-related Proline/Alanine-rich Kinase) 與 OSR1 (Oxidative Stress-Responsive Kinase 1) 激酶信號傳遞鏈。此 WNK4-SPAK/OSR1 Kinase Cascade 突變可引發 Pseudohypoaldosteronism Type II (PHA II / Gordon Syndrome)。

questions.stem: Which set of laboratory findings is most characteristic of classic Gitelman syndrome?

options.text: Hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis with hypercalciuria and normal serum magnesium
Hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis with hypomagnesemia and hypocalciuria

questions.sourceExplanation: Gitelman Syndrome 的四大經典生化標誌為：Hypokalemic Metabolic Alkalosis、顯著且難治的 Hypomagnesemia (伴隨 FEMg > 4%)、顯著的 Hypocalciuria (UCa/UCr < 0.2 mmol/mmol)，以及 Renin/Aldosterone 活化伴隨正常或偏低的 Blood Pressure。

questions.stem: Recessive mutations in the KCNJ10 gene encoding the basolateral Kir4.1 potassium channel cause EAST/SESAME syndrome, which produces a Gitelman-like renal phenotype combined with which extrarenal clinical triad?

options.text: Retinitis pigmentosa, optic atrophy, and ataxia
Sensorineural deafness, corneal dystrophy, and tremor

questions.sourceExplanation: EAST / SESAME Syndrome 是因編碼 DCT 基底側膜 Kir4.1 鉀通道的 KCNJ10 基因發生突變所致。 Kir4.1 對於維持 DCT 上皮細胞基底側膜電位與驅動 Na-K-ATPase 至為關鍵。其缺失會產生 Gitelman-like 腎障礙，並伴隨特徵性的神經學三聯徵：Epilepsy, Ataxia, Sensorineural Deafness。

questions.stem: A 45-year-old kidney transplant recipient receiving tacrolimus develops persistent hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and metabolic alkalosis. What is the main molecular mechanism of tacrolimus-induced Gitelman-like syndrome?

options.text: Upregulation of ENaC subunits in the collecting duct
Inhibition of carbonic anhydrase II in the proximal tubule
Direct down-regulation of NCCT and TRPM6 expression in the DCT
Activation of basolateral CaSR in the thick ascending limb

questions.sourceExplanation: Calcineurin Inhibitors (CNI，如 Tacrolimus 與 Cyclosporine) 是引起 Acquired Gitelman-like Syndrome 最常見的藥物。CNI 會直接下調 DCT 頂端膜上 NCCT 與 TRPM6 離子通道的基因與蛋白表達量，並抑制基底側 EGF 旁分泌，引發腎臟失鈉、失鉀與重度失鎂。

questions.stem: A cancer patient treated with cisplatin chemotherapy develops severe refractory hypomagnesemia and renal potassium wasting. Which mechanism accounts for cisplatin-induced Gitelman-like tubulopathy?

options.text: Overexpression of megalin receptors in the proximal tubule
Selective blockade of NKCC2 cotransporters in the loop of Henle
Stimulation of mineralocorticoid receptors in principal cells
Irreversible distal convoluted tubular injury with down-regulation of TRPM6 and EGF

questions.sourceExplanation: Cisplatin 具備顯著的腎小管毒性，特別容易累積於 DCT 並造成深度的 Direct Tubular Injury。Cisplatin 會嚴重下調 TRPM6 鎂離子通道與 EGF 訊息傳遞，引發持續性甚至不可逆的 Secondary Gitelman-like Hypomagnesemia 與 Potassium Wasting。

questions.stem: A 52-year-old woman with dry eyes and positive anti-SSA/Ro antibodies presents with hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis, hypomagnesemia, and hypocalciuria. Renal biopsy reveals lymphoplasmacytic tubulointerstitial nephritis. What is the underlying cause of her renal presentation?

options.text: IgA nephropathy with secondary distal RTA

questions.sourceExplanation: Sjögren's Syndrome 是引發 Acquired Gitelman-like Syndrome 最典型的自體免疫疾病。 Anti-Ro/SSA 等自體抗體誘發 Lymphoplasmacytic Tubulointerstitial Nephritis，病理浸潤破壞 DCT 上皮細胞功能，導致典型的 Gitelman 樣 Salt Wasting 與電解質異常。

questions.stem: Prolonged administration of high-dose amikacin or gentamicin can induce hypomagnesemia and hypokalemia mimicking Gitelman syndrome through which pathogenetic process?

options.text: Inhibition of Na-K-ATPase in principal cells
Activation of the calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) and acute tubular injury
Stimulation of proximal tubule phosphate reabsorption

questions.sourceExplanation: Aminoglycosides (如 Gentamicin, Amikacin) 帶有高陽電荷，經 Megalin 內吞進入小管細胞後會引發 Acute Tubular Injury；同時Aminoglycosides 可活化 Calcium-Sensing Receptor (CaSR)，進而抑制小管離子重吸收通道，誘發 Gitelman-like 電解質紊亂。

questions.stem: Long-term proton pump inhibitor (PPI) therapy is increasingly recognized as a cause of severe hypomagnesemia that can present with secondary Gitelman-like laboratory features. What is the primary site of PPI-induced magnesium malabsorption?

options.text: Intestinal mucosa via downregulation of TRPM6/TRPM7

questions.sourceExplanation: 長期使用 Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs) 會改變腸道微環境 pH 值，進而下調腸道上皮細胞 (Intestinal Mucosa) 頂端膜 TRPM6/TRPM7 鎂通道的活性與表現，引發腸道鎂吸收障礙與深度的 Hypomagnesemia，臨床上可伴隨 Secondary Gitelman 樣表現。

questions.stem: In distinguishing Gitelman syndrome from Bartter syndrome (Types I-IV), which spot urine test parameter is the most reliable differentiating factor?
questions.sourceExplanation: 鑑別 Gitelman Syndrome (病變在 DCT) 與 Bartter Syndrome (病變在 TAL) 最關鍵且可靠的生化分水嶺為 Spot Urine Calcium-to-Creatinine Ratio (UCa/UCr)。 Gitelman 典型表現為 Hypocalciuria (UCa/UCr < 0.2 mmol/mmol 或 < 0.04 mg/mg)；而 Bartter 典型表現為 Hypercalciuria (UCa/UCr > 0.2 mmol/mmol)，常併發 Nephrocalcinosis。

questions.stem: A patient with hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis and hypercalciuria is found to have hypocalcemia and inappropriately low intact PTH levels. This clinical picture points to which specific entity?

options.text: Gain-of-function (activating) mutation of CaSR (Bartter syndrome type V)

questions.sourceExplanation: Calcium-Sensing Receptor (CaSR) 發生 Gain-of-function (Activating) Mutations 會持續抑制 TAL 的 ROMK 與 NKCC2，引發 Bartter 樣表型 (Type V)；同時過度活化的 CaSR 會持續抑制副甲狀腺釋放 PTH，造成特徵性的 Hypocalcemia 伴隨 Suppressed PTH。相反地，Loss-of-function 突變則導致 Familial Hypocalciuric Hypercalcemia (FHH)。

questions.stem: A 28-year-old woman with active vomiting presents with severe hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis, and a spot urine sodium of 115 mEq/L despite clinical dehydration. Spot urine chloride is 8 mEq/L. How is the high urine sodium explained in this setting?

options.text: Renal salt wasting due to intrinsic DCT damage
Bicarbonaturia paradox, where excess filtered HCO3- acts as a nonreabsorbable anion dragging Na+ into urine
Inhibition of ENaC channels by severe hypokalemia
Secondary hyperaldosteronism impairing proximal sodium uptake

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Active Vomiting 急性期，血中過高的 HCO3- 超越近端小管重吸收極限，過量 HCO3- 湧入遠端小管作為 Nonreabsorbable Anion。為維持電中性，Na+ 與 K+ 被迫隨 HCO3- 一同排入尿中 (Bicarbonaturia Paradox)，導致 UNa > 100 mEq/L；然而 UCl 仍被健全的腎臟壓低至 < 10 mEq/L，此為 Chloride-responsive Metabolic Alkalosis 之特徵。

questions.stem: A 60-year-old hypertension patient taking hydrochlorothiazide displays hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis, hypomagnesemia, and hypocalciuria. How does thiazide diuretic action mimic Gitelman syndrome?

options.text: Thiazides inhibit NKCC2 in the thick ascending limb
Thiazides pharmacologically block the apical NCCT cotransporter in the DCT
Thiazides block basolateral ClC-Kb chloride channels

questions.sourceExplanation: Thiazide Diuretics 的藥理作用正是在 DCT 頂端膜競爭性抑制 NCCT (SLC12A3)。因此，長期使用 Thiazides 所產生的藥理副作用生化譜 (低鉀、低氯性鹼中毒、低血鎂、低尿鈣) 與遺傳性 Gitelman Syndrome 的病理生理表現完全一致。

questions.stem: Which urine electrolyte finding effectively differentiates surreptitious vomiting from Gitelman syndrome in a patient presenting with normotensive hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis?

options.text: Low urine potassium in Gitelman vs high urine potassium in active vomiting
High urine calcium in Gitelman vs low urine calcium in active vomiting
Normal urine magnesium in Gitelman vs low urine magnesium in active vomiting
High urine chloride (> 20 mEq/L) in Gitelman vs low urine chloride (< 10 mEq/L) in active vomiting

questions.sourceExplanation: 在面對 Hypokalemic Metabolic Alkalosis 時，Spot Urine Chloride 是分辨 Chloride-Responsive (Extrarenal Loss) 與 Chloride-Unresponsive (Renal Salt Wasting) 的黃金指標。 Active Vomiting 的 UCl 典型降至 < 10-15 mEq/L；而 Gitelman Syndrome 由於自體 NCCT 缺陷無法吸收氯，即便體內嚴重缺鹽，其 UCl 仍會持續升高 (> 20 mEq/L)。

questions.stem: In evaluating a patient with unexplained hypomagnesemia, a fractional excretion of magnesium (FEMg) greater than what threshold in the setting of hypomagnesemia indicates inappropriate renal magnesium wasting?
questions.sourceExplanation: 當患者處於 Hypomagnesemia 狀態時，健全的腎臟應將 Fractional Excretion of Magnesium (FEMg) 壓低至 < 2% (甚至 < 1%)。若在低血鎂下 FEMg 仍 > 4%，強烈提示存在病理性的 Renal Magnesium Wasting，此為 Gitelman 及 Gitelman-like Syndrome 的重要指標。

questions.stem: What is the expected result of a hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) challenge test in a patient with classic Gitelman syndrome?

options.text: Blunted or absent natriuretic and chloruretic response
Marked increase in urinary calcium excretion

questions.sourceExplanation: Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) Challenge Test 可用於評估 DCT 的 NCCT 功能。正常人在給予 HCTZ 後尿鈉與尿氯排泄量會劇烈增加；而 Gitelman Syndrome 患者由於 NCCT 基因缺陷早已失去功能，給予 HCTZ 後呈現 Blunted or Absent Natriuretic and Chloruretic Response。

questions.stem: What is the primary oral magnesium replacement strategy recommended for patients with Gitelman syndrome or Gitelman-like hypomagnesemia?

options.text: Intravenous magnesium sulfate bolus weekly only
Magnesium hydroxide in a single large morning dose
Organic magnesium salts (such as magnesium L-threonate, pidolate, or aspartate) in divided daily doses

questions.sourceExplanation: Gitelman Syndrome 患者需終生補充鎂離子。相比於無機鎂鹽 (如 Magnesium Oxide 易引發嚴重 Diarrhea)，臨床首選生質利用度較高且腸道副作用較低的 Organic Magnesium Salts (如 Magnesium L-threonate, Pidolate, Aspartate, Gluconate)，並採每日分次給藥。

questions.stem: Which medication can be added to oral potassium and magnesium supplementation in Gitelman syndrome to reduce urinary potassium and magnesium wasting by blocking ENaC in the collecting duct?
questions.sourceExplanation: 對於口服補充依然嚴重失鉀失鎂的 Gitelman 患者，可合併使用 Potassium-Sparing Diuretics。其中 Amiloride 能阻斷 Cortical Collecting Duct 頂端膜的 ENaC，降低管腔負電位，進而減少驅動 K+ 與 Mg2+ 排泄的電位差，有效減少尿液失鉀與失鎂。

questions.stem: In a patient diagnosed with secondary Gitelman-like syndrome due to Sjögren’s syndrome, what is the most appropriate definitive management strategy alongside electrolyte replacement?

options.text: Bilateral nephrectomy and renal replacement therapy
Immunosuppressive therapy (e.g. corticosteroids or disease-modifying agents) to control tubulointerstitial inflammation
High-dose thiazide therapy to upregulate NCCT

questions.sourceExplanation: 對於 Secondary / Acquired Gitelman-like Syndrome，除了補充電解質之外，最核心的處置在於針對病因治療 (Treating Underlying Secondary Etiology)。若為 Sjögren's Syndrome 引發，給予 Immunosuppressive Therapy (如 Corticosteroids 或 DDMARDs) 可控制 Tubulointerstitial Nephritis 浸潤，改善 DCT 功能。
